verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for a Notion-style workspace, but the evidence shows no documented rule or trigger engine in Anytype. The local API, headless CLI "for automation and scripting," MCP server, and agents skill are developer building blocks for constructing automation, not built-in event-to-action rules. Auto-updating Queries and default Templates are adjacent features, not triggered actions, so none of this earns credit.
